notes.title: BETA period ended
notes.content:
We end the BEA period after a vibrant year. For the next few weeks Singulive will be unavailable while we update the software implementing the latest news and responding to all the amazing feedback you have sent us.

Thank you very much for being part of this important moment for us.

Sincerely,
The Singulive Team :)

notes.title: Singulive : Chronicle of the first month
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971337/e9e2c6febb63fd03c8c1c2b7d18495f149f9d31a.jpg[/img]

Since August 13, we have experienced the most exciting days since the beginning of Singulive's production. You, the users, have finally visited the rooms and places that in a few weeks will become part of your musical routine. We especially want to thank you, the users, for giving us valuable feedback to continue improving this amazing platform.

Since launch we have been working to bring Singulive to a new platform, Oculus Quest. We have been working for a few weeks now to bring you not only a Quest experience very similar to the PC version, but we are also finalizing cross-platform testing with voice chat included.

The production team has prioritized the technical advancement of this new version over the two new music advancements that were to be added in the coming days. We believe this is for the greater good and the end result will undoubtedly be worth it. 

We couldn't be more excited about the moments to come. Together, enjoying the artists and the music in an incredible way.

See you in the virtual rooms,
The Singulive production team
